handlers.body:
m_stream->update();
	m_pit->write(offset, data);
logerror("exidy_sound_filter_w = %02X\n", data);

collision ^= m_collision_invert;
	m_int_condition = (ioport("INTSOURCE")->read() & ~0x1c) | (collision & m_collision_mask);

m_palette->set_pen_color(index,
			pal1bit(m_color_latch[2] >> which),
			pal1bit(m_color_latch[1] >> which),
			pal1bit(m_color_latch[0] >> which));
m_pia->portb_w(data);
m_pia->porta_w(data);
m_pia->cb1_w(state);
m_pia->ca1_w(state);
m_pa_callback(data);
m_pb_callback(data);
m_ca2_callback(state);
m_cb2_callback(state);

handlers.parameters: ioport_field &field, u32 param, ioport_value oldval, ioport_value newval
handlers.body: machine().bookkeeping().coin_counter_w(param, newval);
